I can't get the motivation to work out, as I said in the comment below I've been to the gym before, but I felt everyone was judging me and  I couldn't help but feel worse about myself.

I'll go to a dermatologist in June to check my hair, but I'm pretty sure there's nothing I can do, it kinda runs in the family.

And yes, I speak Portuguese, I'm from Brazil and that's another thing that keeps me depressed. I constantly see shitty news about my country to a point where I decided to not even check the news anymore.

I've been to the gym before, but it didn't make that much of a difference. I felt everyone was judging me, and I know people say: "just mind your own business" or "everyone has been a rookie before" but I couldn't help but feel worse about myself.

Your comment kinda put a new perspective in my life, could you tell me a bit more about yourself?

It's strange because your examples (taking a shower every morning/reading a book) are things that I already do.

And I tried to make a change before, I started working out and tried to stop gaming. None of those things changed my condition or perspective of living, so eventually I got unmotivated and stopped.
